svg.title: Pulkit Chauhan
svg.desc: Pulkit Chauhan. C++ systems engineer who contributes to databases and core C++ libraries. Final-year computer science student at UPES, open to software engineering roles from January 2027. Open-source work drawn as branches merging into main: ClickHouse (1 merged, 5 in review); Microsoft STL (1 in review); CCExtractor (21 merged, 1 in review); Boost (1 in review). Upstream C++ PRs to ClickHouse, Boost and Microsoft STL. Peak Codeforces rating 1986, Candidate Master. Google Summer of Code 2026 with CCExtractor.
